entities.name: Oscillatory mode class

entities.name: Quadratic action family
entities.description: An assumed quadratic derivative action. The source operator sign must be reconciled, and stationarity does not certify a minimum.
openObligations: A formula describes a model and constrains candidates; a wave does not physically generate the formula by being its argument.

entities.name: Triadic admission predicate
entities.description: A proposed joint closure test for three modes. Simple-cycle minimality is conditional on the chosen graph class.
openObligations: Three is a conditional simple-loop cardinality. A rule application needs three mode instances, joint constraints and a separate result.

entities.name: Local density ρ
entities.description: For a declared complex field, ρ(x)=|Ψ(x)|². This nonnegative quantity alone does not establish localization or irreducible closure.
openObligations: rho=|Psi|^2 and Gamma=integral rho are different quantities. Neither is alone a closure or localization certificate.

entities.name: Integrated density Γ
entities.description: Γ=∫ρ dμ on a declared support with measure and normalization. Conservation and finiteness require separate conditions.
openObligations: rho=|Psi|^2 and Gamma=integral rho are different quantities. Neither is alone a closure or localization certificate.

entities.name: CRT carrier class — no admitted instance
entities.description: A proposed localized persistent carrier, admitted only after every declared objecthood gate passes. The existing expanded case admits none.
openObligations: Objecthood is the conjunction of localization, nontrivial concentration and persistence. Existing bounded studies admit no CRT instance.

entities.name: Nonlinear action family
entities.description: A candidate interaction model requiring explicit independent fields, constraints and boundedness analysis. Tested completions have not supplied an object-qualified CRT.
openObligations: Specify independent fields, variation and boundedness before using the formula as a formation mechanism. The frozen cubic preflight is negative.

entities.name: Ensemble carrier class
entities.description: A proposed collection of admitted CRT carriers with a specified coupling and demonstrated collective persistence; no such input cohort exists in the current case.
openObligations: Multiple objects do not automatically constitute a collective regime; coupling and collective persistence need independent evaluation.

entities.name: Ensemble action family
entities.description: A proposed coupling functional for admitted carriers. Nonzero coupling alone does not establish a stable collective regime.
openObligations: Keep alternative coupling families with declared variables/units and input/output types.

entities.name: Synchronization observable
entities.description: A collective observable requiring specified variables, phase convention and tolerance. Agreement alone is not a promoted carrier.
openObligations: A collective order descriptor needs a definition and measurement window; synchrony is not sufficient for carrier promotion.

entities.name: Promoted carrier class
entities.description: A proposed effective carrier with a tested state map, dynamics and intervention interface. No effective next-level dynamics have been derived here.
openObligations: An ensemble-quantum is a proposed collective carrier; do not infer empirical quantization or a Standard Model particle.

entities.name: Carrier promotion contract
entities.description: A proposed transition from persistent collective organization to a new state space and admissible operations, tested by a forward abstraction map.
openObligations: Require a forward coarse-graining map, valid effective transitions and evidence. No direct derivation of established quantum fields is available.

entities.name: Admissibility context Ω
entities.description: The author’s foundational possibility context. It is neither an observed material substrate nor a measured physical field in this release.

Spatial distinguishability is a named primitive direction in the proposed scheme, not a derivation of physical space.

The proposed nonlinear CRT functional extends a quadratic field functional with a cubic interaction. Retain model extension only; it does not certify stability.
Local CRT functionals appear as components of the proposed ensemble functional, alongside additional couplings. A local term alone does not define collective persistence.
Synchronization is represented as an observable on a candidate family of carriers. The relation does not say that every ensemble synchronizes.
The premetric frame belongs to the author's formal admissibility context. Only this premetric interpretation is retained, not a derivation of the later indefinite metric.
